# Native CSteamworks names with REAL door implementations in
# mono_steam_door.cpp (all routed to src/trt/bridge_steam.cpp — one Steam
# client, two front doors). Everything else in steamworks.implmap gets a
# fail-visible function from gen-failvisible.py.
#
# NOTE: Steamworks.NET uses the OLD ISteamController_* names for the input
# API (not ISteamInput_*). The bridge's input object serves both.
# NOTE: ISteamUserStats_RequestCurrentStats / RequestGlobalStats are
# deliberately NOT real: the bridge has no stats backend (vtable slots are
# NULL), so the door returns false with a loud log rather than crashing.
# NOTE: the three ISteamController_*ActionData struct returns are real
# doors returning zeroed structs with a loud one-time log: no action
# backend exists, so "no input" is the honest answer.
